pool.text: The name of the city was adopted under the early Ming dynasty.
A new wall was constructed during the Ming dynasty that remains intact.
Manchu bannermen from the garrison were praised for maintaining Manchu culture.
Manchu Lieutenant general Cimbru reported to the Yongzheng emperor after assignment.
The Qing allowed Han civilian men to marry Manchu bannerwomen across garrisons.
Arthur Gostick Shorrock and Moir Duncan founded the Sianfu Mission.
The Ming name was changed back to Xijing between specific years.
The Xi'an Incident took place in the city during the Chinese Civil War.
An aerial battle broke out for the first time over the city.
The People's Liberation Army captured the city from the Kuomintang force.
A Neolithic village known as Banpo was discovered on the eastern outskirts.
The Xi'an Banpo Museum was built to preserve the archaeological collection.
The Lantian Man was discovered in Lantian County near Xi'an.
The Shaanxi Astronomical Observatory was established in the region.
Xi'an and the China Aerospace Corporation set up an industrial base.
The planning of the Xi'an National Civil Aerospace Industrial Base was approved.
The output value from this specific sector exceeded RMB 23 billion.
Line 2 was the first rapid transit line opened to the public.
The city successfully hosted the World Horticultural Exposition.
Xi'an witnessed the largest COVID-19 community outbreak since the initial months.
